review_evidence: Complete unit inventory covers 71 files across Linglib/Pragmatics (50) and Linglib/Discourse (21); 70 own declarations and 57 contain 534 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
The unit formalizes RSA, decision-theoretic and relevance-theoretic pragmatics, social meaning, implicature, signaling games, centering, commitment, QUD and gameboard models.

Representative direct inspection of Pragmatics/RSA/Basic.lean shows probability-kernel definitions of literal listeners/speakers/posteriors and checked Bayes, normalization and preference results; the lone declaration-scan exception is retained rather than inferred to be noise.
summary: Retain the complete Linglib pragmatics/discourse unit as substantive probabilistic and symbolic formal theory.
